{{DISPLAYTITLE:jubbii_cosplay}}
[[File:Jubbii cosplay avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|jubbii_cosplay.]]
'''jubbii_cosplay''' is a cosplayer whose image is used on one [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card prints the credit as "Image courtesy of felixjulien.png, geek_girlz, & jubbii_cosplay @ Instagram". The credit points to Instagram, a photo-sharing site. The same credit line also names felixjulien.png and geek_girlz. The credited card is [[Run'heb Voend|•Run'heb Voend]], in [[Virtual Set 27]] (released 2026).
